svg.title: Five quiz commands, five response types
svg.desc: Examples of the five current Add quiz commands and their supported response types. These are explanatory command cards, not captured slide badges. Command guide illustration, not a screenshot. No live user data.
svg.metadata: Source: addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/Ribbon/LokalRibbon.xml; addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/Ribbon/LokalRibbon.cs; addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/LOKAL.PowerPoint.csproj; assets/*.png. Quiz settings checked against UI/ConfigActivityPanel.cs and UI/ActivityOptionsHelpForm.cs. Authored as a code-native SVG command guide. Existing PNG icons embedded without external image references. Commands using Office imageMso icons are represented by a plain Office label, not a substitute icon.
svg.text: LOKAL / POWERPOINT ADD-IN
Five quiz commands, five response types
Command guide · illustration, not a screenshot
LOKAL / Add quiz / choose a type
Multiple Choice
2–8 choices; allow one answer or multiple selections.
Optional answer key and Quiz mode for automatic stars.
Word Cloud
Collect 1–5 short entries per student.
Show the words as a cloud; award stars manually.
Short Answer
Collect one response or up to three written submissions.
Optional hidden names; review and award stars manually.
Image Upload
Collect uploaded images or camera work.
Optional or required captions; award stars manually.
Fill in the Blanks
Create 1–5 blanks with accepted answer alternatives.
Optional case matching and Quiz mode for automatic stars.
Selecting a type adds its activity to the current slide and opens Activity Options.
View Responses opens collected work; it does not start an activity.
Based on current LOKAL commands. Layout is explanatory, not Office UI.
